Amina (PM): quick thread — need a focused smoke-test checklist for the routing + isolation pilot. target next Wed.
Tom (Eng-Platform): ok. critical pieces: DSL eval, per-route metrics, canary toggle, KV cache warmup.
Priya (Arch): include model fallback matrix + residency enforcement toggle. small DSL subset only for pilot.
Jordan (SRE): runbook items: rollback route, traffic-shift script, pinned-tenant migration play, and pre-provision 2 dedicated test pools.
Nora (Solutions): customers ask for per-route cost caps + a routing preview UI. can we show a rough egress-cost bucket in the preview?
Tom (Eng-Platform): preview UI later. for smoke we can return routing decision + a coarse cost bucket.
Amina (PM): proposed minimal smoke checklist: 1) DSL parser + sample rules, 2) per-route p95 in grafana, 3) routing decision audit logs, 4) canary toggle + rollback script, 5) model compatibility check. thumbs?
Priya (Arch): thumbs. blockers: KV invalidation spike and completing model catalog compatibility. estimate 2 sprints before safe canary.
Jordan (SRE): I'll reserve a short night window for the canary and wire up monitors + automated rollback.
deploy-bot: ci: routing-pilot build #213 succeeded (sha:fa12e) :rocket:
Amina (PM): owners: DSL=Priya; infra=Tom; models=Priya+Jordan; docs/preview=Nora; rollout=Amina/Jordan. reconvene Mon to confirm runbook.
Nora (Solutions): added a sample tenant with residency flag for manual verification.
Tom (Eng-Platform): starting infra spike tomorrow; creating tickets now.
